Session 17's builder (`s17a`–`s17d`) is another standalone script, run the same way; each chunk was built with `ONLY=<its specimens>`:

```ts
// Session 17 (2026-10-24): the questions session 16 left open for #539 and #540.
// s17a: what Word reads through the glossary document (its own relationships part; a footer, footnotes or an unused header it names).
// s17b: a MIME parameter on the content type of parts other than the main part and styles.
// s17c: case, whitespace and a non-charset parameter on the main and styles content types, and a parameterized generic Default.
// s17d: the s17a controls — footnotes, endnotes and comments the glossary references, malformed and well formed, and its relationships part unreferenced.
// Run from the stack worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src [ONLY=a,b] pnpm exec tsx s17builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const WML = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml";
const MAIN = `${WML}.document.main+xml`;
const STYLES = `${WML}.styles+xml`;
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;
const CT = P["[Content_Types].xml"];
const DOC = P["word/document.xml"];
const DOC_RELS = P["word/_rels/document.xml.rels"];
/** Well formed up to a missing end of the root element: namespaces stay declared, the part does not parse. */
const unclosed = (xml: string) => xml.slice(0, xml.lastIndexOf("</"));
const ct = (extra: string) => CT.replace("</Types>", `${extra}</Types>`);
const rels = (extra: string) => DOC_RELS.replace("</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
const relsPart = (body: string) =>
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${body}</Relationships>`;
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!text.includes(from)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};

// --- s17a: the glossary document's reach ---
const HEADER = `<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;
const FOOTER = `<w:ftr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Footer</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:ftr>`;
const FOOTNOTES =
    `<w:footnotes xmlns:w="${W}"><w:footnote w:type="separator" w:id="-1"><w:p><w:r><w:separator/></w:r></w:p></w:footnote>` +
    `<w:footnote w:type="continuationSeparator" w:id="0"><w:p><w:r><w:continuationSeparator/></w:r></w:p></w:footnote>` +
    `<w:footnote w:id="1"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Footnote</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:footnote></w:footnotes>`;
const glossary = (body: string, sectPr: string) =>
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r>${body}</w:p><w:sectPr>${sectPr}</w:sectPr></w:docPartBody>` +
    `</w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
/** A glossary document related from the main part, with its own relationships part and the parts it names. */
const viaGlossary = (o: { glossaryXml: string; glossaryRels: string; parts: Record<string, string>; overrides: string }) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": o.glossaryXml,
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": o.glossaryRels,
        ...o.parts,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(
            `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${WML}.document.glossary+xml"/>${o.overrides}`,
        ),
    });
const HEADER_OVERRIDE = `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/header9.xml" ContentType="${WML}.header+xml"/>`;
const headerRels = relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdH" Type="${REL}/header" Target="header9.xml"/>`);
const headerRef = `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdH"/>`;
const glossaryRelsBroken = (rels: string) =>
    viaGlossary({
        glossaryXml: glossary("", headerRef),
        glossaryRels: rels,
        parts: { "word/glossary/header9.xml": HEADER },
        overrides: HEADER_OVERRIDE,
    });
const footerViaGlossary = (footer: string) =>
    viaGlossary({
        glossaryXml: glossary("", `<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>`),
        glossaryRels: relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="${REL}/footer" Target="footer9.xml"/>`),
        parts: { "word/glossary/footer9.xml": footer },
        overrides: `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/footer9.xml" ContentType="${WML}.footer+xml"/>`,
    });

// --- s17b and s17c: content types with a MIME parameter, case or whitespace ---
const withCt = (from: string, to: string, extraParts: Record<string, string> = {}, extraRels = "", extraCt = "") =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        ...extraParts,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(extraRels),
        "[Content_Types].xml": replaceOnce(ct(extraCt), from, to),
    });
const MAIN_OVERRIDE = `<Override PartName="/word/document.xml" ContentType="${MAIN}"/>`;
const STYLES_OVERRIDE = `<Override PartName="/word/styles.xml" ContentType="${STYLES}"/>`;
/** A settings, fontTable or webSettings part, related from the main part, its Override carrying `contentType`. */
const docPart = (segment: string, file: string, root: string, contentType: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        [`word/${file}`]: `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<w:${root} xmlns:w="${W}"/>`,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${file}"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(`<Override PartName="/word/${file}" ContentType="${contentType}"/>`),
    });
const settingsType = `${WML}.settings+xml`;
const headerInMain = (contentType: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/document.xml": replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(DOC, `xmlns:w="${W}"`, `xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"`),
            "<w:sectPr>",
            `<w:sectPr>${headerRef}`,
        ),
        "word/header9.xml": HEADER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdH" Type="${REL}/header" Target="header9.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(`<Override PartName="/word/header9.xml" ContentType="${contentType}"/>`),
    });

// --- s17d: notes and comments the glossary references ---
const ENDNOTES =
    `<w:endnotes xmlns:w="${W}"><w:endnote w:type="separator" w:id="-1"><w:p><w:r><w:separator/></w:r></w:p></w:endnote>` +
    `<w:endnote w:type="continuationSeparator" w:id="0"><w:p><w:r><w:continuationSeparator/></w:r></w:p></w:endnote>` +
    `<w:endnote w:id="1"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Endnote</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:endnote></w:endnotes>`;
const COMMENTS = `<w:comments xmlns:w="${W}"><w:comment w:id="0" w:author="A"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Comment</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:comment></w:comments>`;
/** A story part the glossary references from its body, through its own relationships part. */
const storyViaGlossary = (segment: string, file: string, xml: string, reference: string) =>
    viaGlossary({
        glossaryXml: glossary(reference, ""),
        glossaryRels: relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdS" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${file}"/>`),
        parts: { [`word/glossary/${file}`]: xml },
        overrides: `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/${file}" ContentType="${WML}.${segment}+xml"/>`,
    });
const footnoteRef = `<w:r><w:footnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`;
const endnoteRef = `<w:r><w:endnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`;
const commentRef = `<w:r><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>`;

const specimens: [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][] = [
    // s17a — #539: what Word reads through the glossary document.
    ["s17a-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
    ["glossary-rels-unclosed", "#539 open question", () => glossaryRelsBroken(unclosed(headerRels))],
    ["glossary-rels-zero-byte", "#539 open question", () => glossaryRelsBroken("")],
    ["footer-ref-in-glossary-malformed", "#539 open question", () => footerViaGlossary(unclosed(FOOTER))],
    ["footer-ref-in-glossary-wellformed-control", "#539 open question", () => footerViaGlossary(FOOTER)],
    [

            }),

    [

    ["s17b-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
```

```ts
// Session 18 (2026-10-24): review AS's S3 — word-valid refuses stored names that differ only by Unicode normalization
// (NFC vs NFD) on Word-folding grounds (#441), but no Word observation backs it. Case-only pairs are observed (#351).
// Run from the stack worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src [ONLY=a,b] pnpm exec tsx s18builder.tmp.mts

const NFD = "café";
/** The minimal package plus unreferenced well-formed XML parts at `names` (typed by the generic xml Default). */
const withParts = (...names: string[]) => buildDocx({ ...P, ...Object.fromEntries(names.map((name) => [name, X])) });

const specimens: [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][] = [
    ["s18a-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],

    ["nfd-name-alone", "S3 calibration", () => withParts(`word/${NFD}.xml`)],
    ["nfc-nfd-part-pair", "#441 S3", () => withParts(`word/${NFC}.xml`, `word/${NFD}.xml`)],
    ["nfc-nfd-folder-pair", "#441 S3", () => withParts(`word/${NFC}/a.xml`, `word/${NFD}/b.xml`)],
    ["case-part-pair-control", "#351 control", () => withParts("word/extra.xml", "word/EXTRA.xml")],
    ["s18a-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    if (only.size > 0 && !only.has(name)) continue;
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid}`,
    );
}
```

Session 19's builder (`s19a`, `s19b`) is another standalone script, run the same way:

```ts
// Session 19 (2026-10-24): #549 made a reached glossary a second story root for its relationships part and the five lazy
// story types, but left the glossary's eagerly parsed relationships (styles, settings, fontTable, webSettings, numbering)
// unfollowed as unobserved. Real Word glossaries carry their own styles, settings, fontTable and webSettings parts.
// Does Word read them at open — does a malformed one get a repair offer?
// Run from the stack worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src [ONLY=a,b] pnpm exec tsx s19builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const REL = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const WML = "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml";
const P = MINIMAL_PARTS as Record<string, string>;
const CT = P["[Content_Types].xml"];
const DOC_RELS = P["word/_rels/document.xml.rels"];
/** Well formed up to a missing end of the root element: namespaces stay declared, the part does not parse. */
const unclosed = (xml: string) => xml.slice(0, xml.lastIndexOf("</"));
const ct = (extra: string) => CT.replace("</Types>", `${extra}</Types>`);
const rels = (extra: string) => DOC_RELS.replace("</Relationships>", `${extra}</Relationships>`);
const relsPart = (body: string) =>
    `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n<Relationships xmlns="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships">${body}</Relationships>`;

// A glossary that references no story: only its eager relationships can reach a part.
const GLOSSARY =
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;

/** Each eager type: relationship segment, stored file under word/glossary/, content type, and a well-formed part. */
const EAGER = {
    styles: { file: "styles.xml", type: `${WML}.styles+xml`, xml: `<w:styles xmlns:w="${W}"></w:styles>` },
    settings: { file: "settings.xml", type: `${WML}.settings+xml`, xml: `<w:settings xmlns:w="${W}"></w:settings>` },
    fontTable: { file: "fontTable.xml", type: `${WML}.fontTable+xml`, xml: `<w:fonts xmlns:w="${W}"></w:fonts>` },
    webSettings: { file: "webSettings.xml", type: `${WML}.webSettings+xml`, xml: `<w:webSettings xmlns:w="${W}"></w:webSettings>` },
    numbering: { file: "numbering.xml", type: `${WML}.numbering+xml`, xml: `<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}"></w:numbering>` },
} as const;
type Eager = keyof typeof EAGER;

/** The minimal package plus a glossary whose own relationships part relates one `segment` part, malformed or not. */
const glossaryWithEager = (segment: Eager, malformed: boolean) => {
    const { file, type, xml } = EAGER[segment];
    return buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": GLOSSARY,
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdE" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${file}"/>`),
        [`word/glossary/${file}`]: malformed ? unclosed(xml) : xml,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(

    ["glossary-fonttable-malformed", "#549 eager", () => glossaryWithEager("fontTable", true)],
    ["glossary-websettings-malformed", "#549 eager", () => glossaryWithEager("webSettings", true)],
    ["s19a-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],

    ["glossary-settings-wellformed-control", "#549 eager", () => glossaryWithEager("settings", false)],

    ["s19b-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {

    );
}
```

```ts
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
```

```ts
const endnoteRef = `<w:r><w:endnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`;
const commentRef = `<w:r><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>`;

const specimens: [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][] = [
    // s23a — #595 and #596 (footer, comments).

    ["glossary-theme-override-exact-control", "#595 control", () => glossaryTheme(ov("word/glossary/theme/theme1.xml", THEME_TYPE))],
    ["glossary-footer-ref-override-charset", "#596", () => footerViaGlossary(T("footer") + CHARSET)],
    ["glossary-footer-ref-override-exact-control", "#596 control", () => footerViaGlossary(T("footer"))],

    // s23b — #596 (footnotes, endnotes).
    ["s23b-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
    [
        "glossary-footnotes-ref-override-charset",
        "#596",
        () => storyViaGlossary("footnotes", "footnotes.xml", FOOTNOTES, footnoteRef, T("footnotes") + CHARSET),
    ],
    [
        "glossary-footnotes-ref-override-exact-control",
        "#596 control",
        () => storyViaGlossary("footnotes", "footnotes.xml", FOOTNOTES, footnoteRef, T("footnotes")),
    ],
    [

        "#596",
        () => storyViaGlossary("endnotes", "endnotes.xml", ENDNOTES, endnoteRef, T("endnotes") + CHARSET),
    ],
    [
        "glossary-endnotes-ref-override-exact-control",
        "#596 control",
        () => storyViaGlossary("endnotes", "endnotes.xml", ENDNOTES, endnoteRef, T("endnotes")),
    ],
    ["s23b-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    if (only.size > 0 && !only.has(name)) continue;
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],

    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(

    );
}
```

```ts
    numbering: { segment: "numbering", file: "numbering.xml", xml: NUMBERING, type: `${WML}.numbering+xml` },
    theme: { segment: "theme", file: "theme/theme1.xml", xml: THEME, type: THEME_TYPE },
    glossary: { segment: "glossaryDocument", file: "glossary/document.xml", xml: glossary(), type: GLOSSARY_TYPE },

        type: `${WML}.comments+xml`,

} as const;
type Used = keyof typeof USED;
const charset = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: USED[k].type + CHARSET });
const exact = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k] });
const generic = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: undefined });

const HEADER = `<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;

/** The part related from the main document but not used: no reference, the main document unchanged. */
const unused = (segment: string, file: string, xml: string, type: string) => mainPart({ segment, file, xml, type: type + CHARSET });

const T = (segment: string) => `${WML}.${segment}+xml`;
const HEADER_REF = docWith("", `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`);
/** A header the main document references from its sectPr, typed `type`. */
const mainHeader = (type: string) => mainPart({ segment: "header", file: "header9.xml", xml: HEADER, type, doc: HEADER_REF });
/** Session 23's glossary that references footer9.xml from its docPartBody's sectPr. */
const glossaryWithFooterRef = () =>
```

The header comments of the session 8–26 builders write the optional filter as `[ONLY=a,b]`: a placeholder, not shell. Run a builder with `BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src pnpm exec tsx s24builder.tmp.mts`, or filter it to exact specimen names with `BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src ONLY=main-footer-typed-header-exact,main-footer-override-exact-control pnpm exec tsx s24builder.tmp.mts`. The builders are kept as they ran.

```ts
    `<w:${kind}s xmlns:w="${W}"><w:${kind} w:type="separator" w:id="-1"><w:p><w:r><w:separator/></w:r></w:p></w:${kind}>` +
    `<w:${kind} w:type="continuationSeparator" w:id="0"><w:p><w:r><w:continuationSeparator/></w:r></w:p></w:${kind}>` +
    `<w:${kind} w:id="1"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Note</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:${kind}></w:${kind}s>`;
const FOOTNOTES = notes("footnote");
const ENDNOTES = notes("endnote");
const COMMENTS = `<w:comments xmlns:w="${W}"><w:comment w:id="0" w:author="A" w:initials="A"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Comment</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:comment></w:comments>`;
const NUMBERING =
    `<w:numbering xmlns:w="${W}"><w:abstractNum w:abstractNumId="0"><w:lvl w:ilvl="0"><w:start w:val="1"/><w:numFmt w:val="decimal"/>` +
    `<w:lvlText w:val="%1."/></w:lvl></w:abstractNum><w:num w:numId="1"><w:abstractNumId w:val="0"/></w:num></w:numbering>`;
const glossary = (body = "") =>
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r>${body}</w:p></w:docPartBody></w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
const GLOSSARY_TYPE = `${WML}.document.glossary+xml`;

/** The minimal package plus a reached glossary whose own relationships part relates `segment` -> `target` (`stored`). */
const glossaryRelating = (segment: string, target: string, stored: string, xml: string, override: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossary(),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdE" Type="${REL}/${segment}" Target="${target}"/>`),
        [stored]: xml,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(`<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${override}`),
    });
const ov = (part: string, type: string) => `<Override PartName="/${part}" ContentType="${type}"/>`;

/** The main document with `r` declared, `run` added after the Hello run, and `sectPr` children prepended. */
const docWith = (run: string, sect = "") =>
    replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(DOC, `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}"`, `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"`),
            "<w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>",
            `<w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>${run}`,
        ),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        `<w:sectPr>${sect}`,
    );
/** A part the main document relates (and uses, through `doc`), typed by an Override with `type`, or by the Default when `type` is undefined. */
const mainPart = (o: { segment: string; file: string; xml: string; type: string | undefined; doc?: string }) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/document.xml": o.doc ?? DOC,
        [`word/${o.file}`]: o.xml,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${REL}/${o.segment}" Target="${o.file}"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": o.type === undefined ? CT : ct(ov(`word/${o.file}`, o.type)),
    });
const USED = {
    numbering: { segment: "numbering", file: "numbering.xml", xml: NUMBERING, type: `${WML}.numbering+xml` },
    glossary: { segment: "glossaryDocument", file: "glossary/document.xml", xml: glossary(), type: GLOSSARY_TYPE },
    footer: {
        segment: "footer",
        file: "footer9.xml",
        xml: FOOTER,
        type: `${WML}.footer+xml`,
        doc: docWith("", `<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`),
    },
    footnotes: {
        segment: "footnotes",
        file: "footnotes.xml",
        xml: FOOTNOTES,
        type: `${WML}.footnotes+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:footnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`),
    },
    endnotes: {
        segment: "endnotes",
        file: "endnotes.xml",
        xml: ENDNOTES,
        type: `${WML}.endnotes+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:endnoteReference w:id="1"/></w:r>`),
    },
    comments: {
        segment: "comments",
        file: "comments.xml",
        xml: COMMENTS,
        type: `${WML}.comments+xml`,
        doc: docWith(`<w:r><w:commentReference w:id="0"/></w:r>`),
    },
} as const;
type Used = keyof typeof USED;
const charset = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: USED[k].type + CHARSET });
const exact = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k] });
const generic = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: undefined });

const HEADER = `<w:hdr xmlns:w="${W}"><w:p><w:r><w:t>Header</w:t></w:r></w:p></w:hdr>`;
const STYLES_TYPE = `${WML}.styles+xml`;
const GLOSSARY_STYLES = `<w:styles xmlns:w="${W}"></w:styles>`;
const padded = (k: Used) => mainPart({ ...USED[k], type: USED[k].type + " " });
/** The part related from the main document but not used: no reference, the main document unchanged. */
const unused = (segment: string, file: string, xml: string, type: string) => mainPart({ segment, file, xml, type: type + CHARSET });

const T = (segment: string) => `${WML}.${segment}+xml`;
const HEADER_REF = docWith("", `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`);
/** A header the main document references from its sectPr, typed `type`. */
const mainHeader = (type: string) => mainPart({ segment: "header", file: "header9.xml", xml: HEADER, type, doc: HEADER_REF });
/** Session 23's glossary that references footer9.xml from its docPartBody's sectPr. */
const glossaryWithFooterRef = () =>
    `<w:glossaryDocument xmlns:w="${W}" xmlns:r="${REL}"><w:docParts><w:docPart><w:docPartPr><w:name w:val="Part"/>` +
    `<w:category><w:name w:val="General"/><w:gallery w:val="placeholder"/></w:category><w:guid w:val="{6A9E2C40-3F1B-4C55-9D2E-7B1A0C9D4E11}"/></w:docPartPr>` +
    `<w:docPartBody><w:p><w:r><w:t>Part</w:t></w:r></w:p><w:sectPr><w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/></w:sectPr></w:docPartBody>` +
    `</w:docPart></w:docParts></w:glossaryDocument>`;
const footerViaGlossary = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossaryWithFooterRef(),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="${REL}/footer" Target="footer9.xml"/>`),
        "word/glossary/footer9.xml": FOOTER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(
            `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${ov("word/glossary/footer9.xml", type)}`,
        ),
    });

/** S-A: the main document's `w:headerReference r:id="rIdX"` where rIdX is a footer-type relationship to a `w:hdr` part. */
const headerViaFooterRel = (type: string) => mainPart({ segment: "footer", file: "header9.xml", xml: HEADER, type, doc: HEADER_REF });
/** S-B: a footer read through rIdX (footer) that an unused header relationship rIdH also targets. */
const footerAlsoUnusedHeader = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/document.xml": USED.footer.doc,
        "word/footer9.xml": FOOTER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(
            `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${REL}/footer" Target="footer9.xml"/><Relationship Id="rIdH" Type="${REL}/header" Target="footer9.xml"/>`,
        ),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(ov("word/footer9.xml", type)),
    });
/** F3: a reached glossary that references header9.xml from its docPartBody's sectPr. */
const headerViaGlossary = (type: string) =>
    buildDocx({
        ...P,
        "word/glossary/document.xml": glossaryWithFooterRef().replace(
            `<w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>`,
            `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdF"/>`,
        ),
        "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels": relsPart(`<Relationship Id="rIdF" Type="${REL}/header" Target="header9.xml"/>`),
        "word/glossary/header9.xml": HEADER,
        "word/_rels/document.xml.rels": rels(`<Relationship Id="rIdG" Type="${REL}/glossaryDocument" Target="glossary/document.xml"/>`),
        "[Content_Types].xml": ct(
            `<Override PartName="/word/glossary/document.xml" ContentType="${GLOSSARY_TYPE}"/>${ov("word/glossary/header9.xml", type)}`,
        ),
    });

const specimens: [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][] = [
    ["s26a-control-minimal", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-footer-exact", "S-A control", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("footer"))],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-footer-charset", "S-A", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("footer") + CHARSET)],
    ["headerref-footer-rel-typed-header-exact", "S-A", () => headerViaFooterRel(T("header"))],
    ["footer-read-unused-header-rel-typed-header", "S-B", () => footerAlsoUnusedHeader(T("header"))],
    ["footer-read-unused-header-rel-typed-footer", "S-B control", () => footerAlsoUnusedHeader(T("footer"))],
    ["glossary-header-typed-footer-exact", "F3", () => headerViaGlossary(T("footer"))],
    ["s26a-control-minimal-end", "control", () => buildDocx(P)],
];
const only = new Set((process.env.ONLY ?? "").split(",").filter(Boolean));

const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    if (only.size > 0 && !only.has(name)) continue;
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid}`,
    );
}
```

Session 27's builder (`s27a`–`s27c`) is another standalone script, run the same way, with `CHUNK` naming the chunk:

```ts
// Session 27 (2026-10-24): the items adversarial review AZ (layer 129, #611) left for a Word probe, plus the
// placements layer 129's check judges without a session 26 observation.
// s27a: S1/S2 — a body headerReference naming a header relationship to a w:hdr part typed header+xml (the clean
//       session 26 shape, `headerref-header-rel-hdr-typed-header`) whose relationship Type is padded with spaces,
//       wrapped in tab/newline character references, upper-cased (`…/HEADER`), `http://example.com/header`, or
//       `…/relationships/custom/header`; S3 — the same clean shape plus a second Relationship with the same Id rIdX,
//       Type footer, listed last.
// s27b: S3 mirror — the session 26 refused shape (headerReference → footer relationship rIdX to a w:ftr part) plus a
//       second rIdX of Type header listed last; the refused shape with its reference moved into a paragraph-level
//       w:pPr/w:sectPr, or into the w:sectPr of a w:sectPrChange (with the clean shape moved there as its control: the
//       schema's CT_SectPrBase has no header reference at all); the clean shape with relationship Type "header" (no URI),
//       or the ISO Strict header relationship URI (http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/header).
// s27c: the footer side of s27a/s27b's URI results — a body footerReference naming a footer relationship to a w:ftr part
//       typed footer+xml whose Type is `http://example.com/footer`, `…/relationships/custom/footer`, `…/FOOTER`, or the
//       ISO Strict footer URI, with the unmodified shape as a control.
// Shapes: tests/support/story-content-type-specimens.ts at 9eb10acb (`storyReferenceParts`), as review AZ's probe-az.
// Run from a worktree root at 9eb10acb as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s27a|s27b|s27c pnpm exec tsx s27builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { STORY_FOOTER_XML, STORY_HEADER_XML, storyContentType, storyReferenceParts } from "./tests/support/story-content-type-specimens";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const REF = `<w:headerReference w:type="default" r:id="rIdX"/>`;
const clean = (): Parts => storyReferenceParts("headerReference", "header", "header9.xml", STORY_HEADER_XML, storyContentType("header"));
const refused = (): Parts => storyReferenceParts("headerReference", "footer", "footer9.xml", STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType("footer"));
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!text.includes(from)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const edit = (parts: Parts, file: string, from: string, to: string): Parts => ({ ...parts, [file]: replaceOnce(parts[file]!, from, to) });
const RELS = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
const DOC = "word/document.xml";
const retype = (type: string) => edit(clean(), RELS, `Type="${R}/header"`, `Type="${type}"`);
const control = () => buildDocx(MINIMAL_PARTS);
/** The body sectPr's reference moved into a w:sectPrChange, its last child (CT_SectPr), inside that change's w:sectPr. */
const inSectPrChange = (parts: Parts): Parts =>
    edit(
        edit(parts, DOC, REF, ""),
        DOC,
        "</w:sectPr></w:body>",
        `<w:sectPrChange w:id="1" w:author="A" w:date="2026-10-24T00:00:00Z"><w:sectPr>${REF}</w:sectPr></w:sectPrChange></w:sectPr></w:body>`,
    );

const cleanFooter = (): Parts =>
    storyReferenceParts("footerReference", "footer", "footer9.xml", STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType("footer"));
const retypeFooter = (type: string) => edit(cleanFooter(), RELS, `Type="${R}/footer"`, `Type="${type}"`);

const chunks: Record<string, [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][]> = {
    s27a: [
        ["s27a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-padded", "AZ S1", () => buildDocx(retype(` ${R}/header `))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-tab-newline", "AZ S1", () => buildDocx(retype(`&#x9;${R}/header&#xA;`))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-upper", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype(`${R}/HEADER`))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-example-com", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype("http://example.com/header"))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-custom-header", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype(`${R}/custom/header`))],
        [
            "headerref-duplicate-id-last-footer",
            "AZ S3",
            () =>
                buildDocx(
                    edit(
                        clean(),
                        RELS,
                        "</Relationships>",
                        `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${R}/footer" Target="header9.xml"/></Relationships>`,
                    ),
                ),
        ],
        ["s27a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s27b: [
        ["s27b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "headerref-duplicate-id-last-header",
            "AZ S3 mirror",
            () =>
                buildDocx(
                    edit(
                        refused(),
                        RELS,
                        "</Relationships>",
                        `<Relationship Id="rIdX" Type="${R}/header" Target="footer9.xml"/></Relationships>`,
                    ),
                ),
        ],
        [
            "headerref-footer-rel-paragraph-sectpr",
            "placement",
            () => {
                const p = edit(refused(), DOC, REF, "");
                return buildDocx(edit(p, DOC, "<w:r>", `<w:pPr><w:sectPr>${REF}</w:sectPr></w:pPr><w:r>`));
            },
        ],
        ["headerref-footer-rel-in-sectprchange", "placement", () => buildDocx(inSectPrChange(refused()))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-in-sectprchange", "placement control", () => buildDocx(inSectPrChange(clean()))],
        ["headerref-header-rel-type-bare", "AZ S2", () => buildDocx(retype("header"))],
        [
            "headerref-header-rel-type-strict-uri",
            "AZ S2",
            () => buildDocx(retype("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/header")),
        ],
        ["s27b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s27c: [
        ["s27c-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-example-com", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter("http://example.com/footer"))],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-custom-footer", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter(`${R}/custom/footer`))],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-type-upper", "AZ S2 footer", () => buildDocx(retypeFooter(`${R}/FOOTER`))],
        [
            "footerref-footer-rel-type-strict-uri",
            "AZ S2 footer",
            () => buildDocx(retypeFooter("http://purl.oclc.org/ooxml/officeDocument/relationships/footer")),
        ],
        ["footerref-footer-rel-ftr-typed-footer", "control (session 26 clean footer shape)", () => buildDocx(cleanFooter())],
        ["s27c-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
```

Session 32's builder (`s32a`) is another standalone script, run the same way, with `CHUNK` naming the chunk:

```ts
// Session 32 (2026-10-25): adversarial review BD's suspected items on #618 (layer 129, #611). Every XML check is gated on
// a part name ending in .xml, so a main document stored as word/document.bin is never parsed: a malformed one, or one
// whose r:id names no relationship, passes every profile. Session 31 showed Word reads such a main document's sidecar.
// s32a: MINIMAL_PARTS with the main document truncated (its closing `</w:body></w:document>` removed), stored as
//       word/document.xml (calibration) and as word/document.bin (package relationship, Override and sidecar renamed);
//       the main document's sectPr given a `w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rId9"` (xmlns:r declared), with its
//       .rels removed, or kept without an rId9, each stored as .xml (calibration) and as .bin.
// Shapes: tests/support/minimal-docx.ts and review BD's report.
// Run from a worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s32a pnpm exec tsx s32builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";

const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
type Parts = Record<string, string>;
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string, to: string) => {
    if (!text.includes(from)) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return text.replace(from, to);
};
const CT = "[Content_Types].xml";
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const RELS = "word/_rels/document.xml.rels";
/** Rename the main document to word/document.bin, with its sidecar (when present), Override and package relationship. */
const toBin = (parts: Parts): Parts => {
    const out: Parts = { ...parts };
    out["word/document.bin"] = out[MAIN]!;
    delete out[MAIN];
    if (out[RELS] !== undefined) {
        out["word/_rels/document.bin.rels"] = out[RELS]!;
        delete out[RELS];
    }
    out[CT] = replaceOnce(out[CT]!, 'PartName="/word/document.xml"', 'PartName="/word/document.bin"');
    out["_rels/.rels"] = replaceOnce(out["_rels/.rels"]!, 'Target="word/document.xml"', 'Target="word/document.bin"');
    return out;
};
const truncated = (): Parts => ({ ...(MINIMAL_PARTS as Parts), [MAIN]: replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[MAIN]!, "</w:body></w:document>", "") });
/** The main document's sectPr references footer rId9; `sidecar: false` removes its .rels, otherwise the .rels has no rId9. */
const footerRef = (sidecar: boolean): Parts => {
    const parts: Parts = { ...(MINIMAL_PARTS as Parts) };
    parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", `<w:document xmlns:r="${R}" `),
        "<w:sectPr>",
        '<w:sectPr><w:footerReference w:type="default" r:id="rId9"/>',
    );
    if (!sidecar) delete parts[RELS];
    return parts;
};
const control = () => buildDocx(MINIMAL_PARTS);

const chunks: Record<string, [string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array> | Uint8Array][]> = {
    s32a: [
        ["s32a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        ["main-truncated", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S1)", () => buildDocx(truncated())],
        ["bin-main-truncated", "review BD S1", () => buildDocx(toBin(truncated()))],
        ["footerref-rid-no-sidecar", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S2)", () => buildDocx(footerRef(false))],
        ["bin-footerref-rid-no-sidecar", "review BD S2", () => buildDocx(toBin(footerRef(false)))],
        ["footerref-rid-missing", "calibration (.xml twin of review BD S2)", () => buildDocx(footerRef(true))],
        ["bin-footerref-rid-missing", "review BD S2", () => buildDocx(toBin(footerRef(true)))],
        ["s32a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
// s34a: C, a malformed main document reached through the Fallback officeDocument relationship; D, a zero-byte

// s34b: F, a malformed docProps/core.xml reached through a Fallback core-properties relationship; H, session 26's
//       footer typed as a header (#600) with its relationship in the Fallback; each with its direct twin; I,
//       mc:MustUnderstand="foo" on the _rels/.rels root (review finding 4); L, the footer relationship in an mc:Choice
//       whose Requires prefix is undeclared, Fallback empty (an mce-malformed AlternateContent; review finding 4).
// s34c/s34d: I and L each alone beside a control, after Word crashed during s34b.

// relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens}.ts at layer 131.

import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { STORY_FOOTER_XML, storyContentType, storyReferenceParts } from "./tests/support/story-content-type-specimens";
import {

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");

for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {

    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
        return {
            valid: r.valid,
            errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
        };
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
//       (S2: the main document stored as word/doc2.xml).

//       with no Choice, and a foreign child of mc:AlternateContent), each keeping the styles relationship. Then #638's
//       boundary: a chart part with c:externalData r:id and no .rels, related by a chart relationship, stored outside word/
//       and under it.
// s36c: the adversarial review of layer 131 (#634, #635; pi glm-5.3), suspected findings S2–S4 and the shape behind
//       proven finding P1 (#640): a _rels/.rels whose root is an mc:AlternateContent with the whole Relationships
//       element in its Fallback (S3), or with two bare Relationship elements there (#640: processing leaves two roots);
//       session 26's footer relationship inside an ignorable x:Wrap that mc:ProcessContent names (S2) and inside one it
//       does not (S2's mirror, where markup compatibility drops the relationship); and an rId2 in both an understood
//       w14 mc:Choice and its mc:Fallback beside the direct officeDocument rId1 (S4: a duplicate only in the stored
//       bytes).
// s36d: what s36a–s36c left open. A chart that an inline drawing in word/document.xml references (s36b's charts were
//       related but referenced by nothing), with no chart sidecar while c:externalData names rId1, in word/ and outside
//       it, and with no c:externalData (the drawing's own control); and the s36a malformed AlternateContent sibling in
//       the sidecar of a Word-read non-story part (styles) and of a story part (footer).
// s36e: whether s36a's rule follows the relationship or the path: the main document stored as word/doc2.xml with the
//       malformed sibling, and with mc:MustUnderstand, in its own sidecar word/_rels/doc2.xml.rels; mc:MustUnderstand
//       on a stray word/_rels/document.xml.rels root (s36a's stray shape); and on the glossary document's sidecar root.

import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";

import { MCE_DECLARATIONS, wrapRelationship } from "./tests/support/relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens";

const MC = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/markup-compatibility/2006";

const MALFORMED_SIBLING = '<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="nope"/><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent></Relationships>';

    replaceOnce(replaceOnce(rels, "<Relationships ", `<Relationships xmlns:mc="${MC}" `), "</Relationships>", MALFORMED_SIBLING);

const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        // #640: validate() throws on some shapes at the built commit; record the throw instead of stopping.
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```

```ts
};
const rel = (id: string, type: string, target: string) => `<Relationship Id="${id}" Type="${R}/${type}" Target="${target}"/>`;
const rels = (body: string) => `${XML_DECLARATION}<Relationships xmlns="${PR}">${body}</Relationships>`;

// A chart related from a reached story's sidecar as rId9; `referenced` puts CHART_DRAWING before the story's first paragraph.
const storyChart = (source: "header" | "footnote" | "glossary", referenced: boolean) => {
    let p: Record<string, string>, part: string, side: string;
    if (source === "header") {
        p = storyContentTypeParts("header", storyContentType("header"));
        part = "word/header9.xml";
        side = "word/_rels/header9.xml.rels";
    } else {
        p = glossaryStoryParts("footnotes", true, true);
        part = source === "glossary" ? "word/glossary/document.xml" : "word/glossary/footnotes.xml";
        side = source === "glossary" ? "word/glossary/_rels/document.xml.rels" : "word/glossary/_rels/footnotes.xml.rels";
    }
    p[CH] = barChartXml(true);
    p[CT] = replaceOnce(p[CT]!, "</Types>", `<Override PartName="/${CH}" ContentType="${CHART_CONTENT_TYPE}"/></Types>`);
    p[side] = replaceOnce(
        p[side] ?? rels(""),
        "</Relationships>",
        rel("rId9", "chart", source === "header" ? "charts/chart1.xml" : "../charts/chart1.xml") + "</Relationships>",
    );
    if (referenced) {
        let xml = replaceOnce(
            p[part]!,
            /(<w:\w+)(\s)/,
            `$1 xmlns:w14="${W14}" xmlns:wp="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/wordprocessingDrawing" xmlns:a="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main" xmlns:c="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/chart"$2`,
        );
        xml = xml.replaceAll(` xmlns:r="${R}"`, "");
        xml = replaceOnce(xml, /(<w:\w+)/, `$1 xmlns:r="${R}"`);
        p[part] = replaceOnce(xml, "<w:p>", CHART_DRAWING + "<w:p>");
    }
    return buildDocx(p);
};
// The main document's drawing behind an mc:Fallback: `selected` puts an unselected Choice before it.
const fallbackChart = (selected: boolean) => {
    const p = referencedChartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml", true);
    p[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
        replaceOnce(
            p[MAIN]!,
            CHART_DRAWING,
            `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="${selected ? "foo" : "w14"}"/><mc:Fallback>${CHART_DRAWING}</mc:Fallback></mc:AlternateContent>`,
        ),
        "<w:document ",
        '<w:document xmlns:foo="urn:foo" ',
    );
    return buildDocx(p);
};

    const p = referenced ? referencedChartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml", true) : chartSpecimenParts(CH, "charts/chart1.xml");
    p[DR] = replaceOnce(p[DR]!, "</Relationships>", rel("rId8", "chart", "charts/chart1.xml") + "</Relationships>");

    p[DR] = replaceOnce(p[DR]!, 'Target="charts/chart1.xml"', 'Target="CHARTS/%63hart1.xml"');
    return buildDocx(p);
};

const DECL = `xmlns:mc="${MC}" xmlns:foo="urn:foo" xmlns:w14="${W14}"`;
// The package part's own Relationships element, without its XML declaration.
const PLAIN = replaceOnce(MINIMAL_PARTS[PK]!, XML_DECLARATION, "");
const wrap = (xml: string) =>

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s39a: [
```

Session 40's builder (`s40a`, `s40b`) is another standalone script, run the same way from the layer 135 worktree, with `CHUNK` naming the chunk:

```ts
// Session 40 (2026-10-25): the Word evidence #653 and #665 ask for before their fixes change a verdict or an output
// Word could see. #653: repairMissingParaIds now declares w14 on the stamped part's root and lists it in mc:Ignorable;
// s40a shows Word the repaired bytes the fix writes (taken from the real repair, not rebuilt) and release's shape, with
// xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and no Ignorable entry. #665: the file-reference walk no longer resolves a
// TargetMode="External" target as a part under strict and word-valid. Word-valid changes only for External targets
// the rels-broken blocking predicate keeps (`.rels`, `/_rels/`, `../customXml/`), so s40a/s40b show Word those, as a
// direct child and inside a selected w14 Choice, plus one a w:hyperlink names and one `file:///…pdf` reference.
// Run from the layer 135 worktree root as a copy: BUILD_DIR=<chunk>/src CHUNK=s40a pnpm exec tsx s40builder.tmp.mts
import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
import { appendFileSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { NS } from "./src/lib/types";
import { validate } from "./src/scripts/office/validate";
import { DOCXSchemaValidator } from "./src/scripts/office/validators/docx";
import { MINIMAL_PARTS, buildDocx } from "./tests/support/minimal-docx";
import { DOCUMENT_RELS, MCE_DECLARATIONS } from "./tests/support/relationships-markup-compatibility-specimens";

const W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main";
const W14 = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2010/wordml";
const W15 = "http://schemas.microsoft.com/office/word/2012/wordml";
const R = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships";
const HYPERLINK = `${R}/hyperlink`;
const MAIN = "word/document.xml";
const replaceOnce = (text: string, from: string | RegExp, to: string): string => {
    const next = text.replace(from, to);
    if (next === text) throw new Error(`missing ${from}`);
    return next;
};

// tests/paraid-repair-w14-ignorable.test.ts: a main document whose root carries `rootAttributes` and whose two
// paragraphs and one table row have no ids.
const withoutParaIds = (rootAttributes: string): Record<string, string> => ({
    ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
    [MAIN]:
        `<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n` +
        `<w:document xmlns:w="${W}"${rootAttributes}><w:body>` +
        `<w:p><w:r><w:t>one</w:t></w:r></w:p>` +
        `<w:tbl><w:tblPr><w:tblW w:w="0" w:type="auto"/></w:tblPr><w:tblGrid><w:gridCol w:w="4000"/></w:tblGrid>` +
        `<w:tr><w:tc><w:p/></w:tc></w:tr></w:tbl>` +
        `<w:sectPr><w:pgSz w:w="12240" w:h="15840"/></w:sectPr></w:body></w:document>`,
});

// The bytes repairMissingParaIds writes for `parts`, read back from the directory it repaired.
const workRoot = path.join(process.env.BUILD_DIR ?? ".", "..", "work");
const repairedParts = async (name: string, parts: Record<string, string>): Promise<Record<string, string>> => {
    const dir = path.join(workRoot, name);
    for (const [part, xml] of Object.entries(parts)) {
        mkdirSync(path.dirname(path.join(dir, part)), { recursive: true });
        writeFileSync(path.join(dir, part), xml, "utf-8");
    }
    const repairs = await new DOCXSchemaValidator({ unpackedDir: dir }).repairMissingParaIds();
    if (repairs !== 6) throw new Error(`${name}: expected 6 stamps, got ${repairs}`);
    const out: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { recursive: true, withFileTypes: true })) {
        if (!entry.isFile()) continue;
        const file = path.join(entry.parentPath, entry.name);
        out[path.relative(dir, file).split(path.sep).join("/")] = readFileSync(file, "utf-8");
    }
    return out;
};
const repaired = async (name: string, rootAttributes: string) => buildDocx(await repairedParts(name, withoutParaIds(rootAttributes)));

// Release's repair shape: the same stamps with xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and the root left as it was.
const releaseShape = async () => {
    const parts = await repairedParts("653-release-repair-shape", withoutParaIds(""));
    const fixed = replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, ` xmlns:mc="${NS.MC}" xmlns:w14="${W14}" mc:Ignorable="w14"`, "");
    const release = fixed.replace(/<w:(p|tr) w14:paraId=/g, `<w:$1 xmlns:w14="${W14}" w14:paraId=`);
    if ((release.match(/xmlns:w14=/g) ?? []).length !== 3) throw new Error("release shape: expected three stamped elements");
    return buildDocx({ ...parts, [MAIN]: release });
};

// tests/rels-external-target.integration.test.ts: the minimal package plus hyperlink relationship rId9 to `target`,
// a direct child or inside a selected w14 Choice; `referenced` adds a w:hyperlink naming rId9.
const withHyperlink = (target: string, placement: "direct" | "choice", referenced = false) => {
    const relationship = `<Relationship Id="rId9" Type="${HYPERLINK}" Target="${target}" TargetMode="External"/>`;
    const content =
        placement === "direct"
            ? relationship
            : `<mc:AlternateContent><mc:Choice Requires="w14">${relationship}</mc:Choice><mc:Fallback/></mc:AlternateContent>`;
    const rels = MINIMAL_PARTS[DOCUMENT_RELS]!;
    const parts: Record<string, string> = {
        ...MINIMAL_PARTS,
        [DOCUMENT_RELS]: replaceOnce(
            placement === "direct" ? rels : replaceOnce(rels, "<Relationships ", `<Relationships ${MCE_DECLARATIONS} `),
            "</Relationships>",
            `${content}</Relationships>`,
        ),
    };
    if (referenced) {
        parts[MAIN] = replaceOnce(
            replaceOnce(parts[MAIN]!, "<w:document ", `<w:document xmlns:r="${R}" `),
            "<w:r><w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r>",
            `<w:hyperlink r:id="rId9"><w:r><w:t>Hello</w:t></w:r></w:hyperlink>`,
        );
    }
    return buildDocx(parts);
};
const control = () => buildDocx({ ...MINIMAL_PARTS });

const chunks: Record<string, Array<[string, string, () => Promise<Uint8Array>]>> = {
    s40a: [
        ["s40a-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "653-repaired-root-w14",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root with neither w14 nor mc (root gains both, mc:Ignorable="w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-root-w14", ""),
        ],
        [
            "653-repaired-root-w14-w15",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root listing w15 (mc:Ignorable="w15 w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-root-w14-w15", ` xmlns:w15="${W15}" xmlns:mc="${NS.MC}" mc:Ignorable="w15"`),
        ],
        [
            "653-repaired-compat-prefix",
            '#653: the repair\'s output for a root binding compat to the MC namespace (compat:Ignorable="w15 w14")',
            () => repaired("653-repaired-compat-prefix", ` xmlns:compat="${NS.MC}" compat:Ignorable="w15" xmlns:w15="${W15}"`),
        ],
        ["653-release-repair-shape", "#653: release's output, xmlns:w14 on each stamped element and no Ignorable entry", releaseShape],
        [
            "665-external-file-pdf-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/missing.pdf, direct child, no reference",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/missing.pdf", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels, direct child, no reference",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "direct"),
        ],
        ["s40a-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
    s40b: [
        ["s40b-control-minimal", "control", control],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-underscore-rels-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml, direct child",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-underscore-rels-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///C:/docs/_rels/missing.xml", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-customxml-direct",
            "#665: External hyperlink ../customXml/missing.xml, direct child",
            () => withHyperlink("../customXml/missing.xml", "direct"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-customxml-choice",
            "#665: External hyperlink ../customXml/missing.xml in a selected w14 Choice",
            () => withHyperlink("../customXml/missing.xml", "choice"),
        ],
        [
            "665-external-file-rels-referenced",
            "#665: External hyperlink file:///missing.rels, direct child, named by a w:hyperlink",
            () => withHyperlink("file:///missing.rels", "direct", true),
        ],
        ["s40b-control-minimal-end", "control", control],
    ],
};

const chunk = process.env.CHUNK ?? "";
const specimens = chunks[chunk];
if (!specimens) throw new Error(`CHUNK must be one of ${Object.keys(chunks).join(", ")}`);
const dir = process.env.BUILD_DIR;
if (!dir) throw new Error("BUILD_DIR is required");
mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
for (const [name, issue, make] of specimens) {
    const bytes = await make();
    const file = `${name}.docx`;
    writeFileSync(path.join(dir, file), bytes);
    const sha256 = createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
    const verdict = async (profile: "word-valid" | "strict") => {
        try {
            const r = await validate(path.join(dir, file), { profile });
            return {
                valid: r.valid,
                errors: [...new Set(r.issues.filter((x) => x.severity === "error").map((x) => `${x.code}@${x.path ?? "-"}`))],
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return { valid: null, errors: [`threw:${(error as Error).name}:${(error as Error).message.slice(0, 80)}`] };
        }
    };
    const row = { name, issue, file, sha256, calibration: false, wordValid: await verdict("word-valid"), strict: await verdict("strict") };
    appendFileSync(path.join(dir, "..", "specimens.jsonl"), JSON.stringify(row) + "\n");
    console.log(
        `built ${file} ${sha256.slice(0, 16)} word-valid=${row.wordValid.valid} ${row.wordValid.errors.join(",")} strict=${row.strict.valid} ${row.strict.errors.join(",")}`,
    );
}
```
